name: RFM95Socket
keywords: lora, rfm95, sx1276, socket, messaging, transport
description: Socket-like API for the RFM95 (LoRa) radio, layered on sandeepmistry/arduino-LoRa. ESP32-only: the pin defaults target the SparkFun ESP32 LoRa 1-CH Gateway (SCK 14 / MISO 12 / MOSI 13 / CS 16 / DIO0 26; RESET is not wired to the ESP32, pass -1). Unlike RFM69Socket the radio has no node addressing of its own, so rfm95_socket_hdr_t plus the software filter in getMsg() is the entire addressing mechanism. UNENCRYPTED — the RFM95 has no AES in hardware.
